title: deterministic-int8-llm-inference: measurement programme and reproducibility companion for two papers on cross-kernel INT8 inference numerics
description: The pre-registration, measurement harness, analysis code and measurement artifacts for two papers. The Integer Alibi (arXiv:2608.13756) localizes cross-kernel divergence in INT8-quantized LLM inference to the epilogue, using the exactness of INT32 accumulation under a verified bound. Deterministic LLM Inference Across GPU Kernels (arXiv:2609.00363) measures what a tolerance-based conformance suite detects under injected faults, and the cost of serving with power-of-two weight scales. Re-analysis runs on a CPU. Errors found in arXiv:2609.00363v1 after publication are listed in experiment/CORRECTIONS.md.
